cim: Stripe expands its artificial intelligence partnerships
cim_eredeti: Stripe expands its artificial intelligence partnerships
szoveg_eredeti:
Irish-born entrepreneur John Collison, co-founder and president of payments company Stripe, has been nominated to Microsoft’s board of directors.

By TPN, in Europe, Business · 08 Nov 2026, 13:33 · 0 Comments

The 36-year-old, who founded Stripe with his brother Patrick in 2010, brings experience in technology and entrepreneurship. Businesses using Stripe processed $1.9 trillion in payments during 2025. Shareholders will vote on Collison’s appointment on 8 December.

Microsoft and Stripe already collaborate on Copilot Checkout, allowing US customers to purchase products through Microsoft’s AI assistant. Stripe is also developing payment solutions for AI agents, including partnerships with Sierra and OpenRouter.

Meanwhile, Microsoft shareholders will consider a proposed $90.6 million compensation package for chief executive Satya Nadella, approximately 6% below the previous year’s figure.
